title: 국가안보실 직제 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00009:part:1/1

Article 7 (Number of Public Officials Assigned to the Office of National Security)
(1) The number of public officials assigned to the Office of National Security shall be as specified in the attached Table.
(2) The number of public officials assigned to the Office of National Security by grade shall be determined by directives, established rules, or other methods. [Newly Inserted on April 11, 2023.]
(3) The personnel required may be appointed as fixed-term public officials within 20 percent of the quota of general-service public officials assigned to the Office of National Security. [Amended on December 11, 2013; April 11, 2023.]
(4) The personnel required may be substituted with general-service public officials in Grade III or IV or special-service public officials of equivalent rank, within 30 percent of the quota of public officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service among public officials assigned to the Office of National Security. [Newly Inserted on August 1, 2018; Amended on April 11, 2023.]
